tips.text: Join an active clan that already finished the Itzal research instead of researching it yourself.
Leave any clan that asks for materials before it lets you buy blueprints; plenty of maxed clans ask for nothing.
Buy all four blueprints before you leave the clan; lab access ends with membership.
Expect a shopping trip, not a grind: four blueprint purchases and a foundry wait if your clan has the lab done.
